answer: Epoch-linked model fingerprint. Each identity must present a model relic whose weights were trained under a committed seed, plus a cedar watermark keyed to the prior epoch. Enforcement: the current epoch's outputs must match the prior epoch's behavioural signature within tolerance; drift beyond it blocks rewards. Attackers cannot forge a consistent lineage cheaply, since each sybil requires fresh training and a matching history, costing compute per identity, not a one-time fee.
